editorial.blurb: Lalo's on Maxwell serves authentic Mexican comfort food with genuine warmth, where fresh tortillas and house-made salsa arrive at your table before you've settled in.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive on a cold day or game day to experience the full vibe — the complimentary chips, salsa, and warm chicken soup are part of what makes the place special, and staff are particularly attentive when it's busy.
